sourceObservations: The native asset has THREE horizontal blank wooden plank meshes, four small navy fasteners, and two brown posts. The three meshes occupy one .90-wide stacked panel; all surfaces remain available for dynamic sign content.
The source uses golden orange boards with abrupt bright upper facets and darker horizontal lower bands. Posts become almost black in their lower stretches, weakening warm material readability.
The silhouette and two-post construction are clear. Existing narrow bevels retain a hard manufactured appearance, while the four tiny navy fasteners read as restrained hardware.
The source is a front-edge overlay that may share a plant tile. Its geometry occupies the front band and must not be enlarged toward the center of that tile.
targetObservations: The target suggests broad honey-gold transitions, softly rounded highlight rolloff, warm readable brown posts, and dark blue fasteners with restrained brighter edges.

The target depicts only TWO broad boards, enlarged/inflated fasteners, stronger rounding, visible wood grain, and altered image padding. These are not authority to modify native board count, hardware dimensions, registered silhouette, camera, roots or scale.

Subtle material variation is useful only if the face stays calm and blank at intended size. Painted grain, halo/fringe pixels, extra rounding and padded target composition are optional or undesirable drift, not mandatory details.
